classification.difficultyReason: Factor each quadratic to obtain its roots, sketch using the leading coefficient, then translate the required above-axis or below-axis region into intervals with correct endpoint inclusion.

content.prompt: Solve the following inequalities by sketching an appropriate graph.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x^2-1&=(x-1)(x+1)\end{align*}$$
The parabola opens upwards and is on or above the $x$-axis when $x\le-1$ or $x\ge1$.

spec.description: Solution sketch with roots labelled; no grid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}4-x^2&=(2-x)(2+x)\end{align*}$$
The parabola opens downwards and is above the $x$-axis between its roots. Hence $-2<x<2$.

spec.description: Solution sketch with roots labelled; no grid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x^2-5x+4&=(x-1)(x-4)\end{align*}$$
The parabola opens upwards and is on or below the $x$-axis between its roots. Hence $1\le x\le4$.

spec.description: Solution sketch with roots labelled; no grid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}6-x-x^2&=-(x+3)(x-2)\end{align*}$$
The parabola opens downwards and lies below the $x$-axis outside its roots. Hence $x<-3$ or $x>2$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2x^2+7x+5&=(2x+5)(x+1)\end{align*}$$
The parabola opens upwards and lies below the $x$-axis between $x=-\frac52$ and $x=-1$. Hence $-\frac52<x<-1$.
